CertiChain – Blockchain-Based Certificate Verification System
 
Minimart – Store Inventory Management System
 
Resume Checker – Python Based Web Application
 
An intelligent causal search platform that explains why events happen on the internet instead of returning links. internet.ai
analyzes signals from social, news, and market data to reveal what triggered trends, memes, and price movements. Features
include causal timelines, relationship graphs, and explanation dashboards that help users understand online behavior,
narrative shifts, and digital phenomena clearly and intuitively.
A Blockchain-based certificate management application that connects educational institutions, students, and recruiters for
secure academic verification. The system issues tamper-proof certificates by storing unique hashes and IDs on the
blockchain, ensuring authenticity and preventing forgery. It supports instant verification through certificate ID, hash, or
QR code scanning, and displays verified student details via a secure web interface. The platform provides fast, reliable
validation, reduces manual verification delays, and builds trust between institutions, students, and employers.
 
A MERN stack-based Minimart inventory management solution that helps small stores track products, manage stock
levels, and monitor sales efficiently. The system automates updates, prevents out-of-stock issues, and supports basic
reporting for better business decisions. It simplifies daily operations, making store management faster and more organized.
Resume Checker is a Python-based platform that helps users analyze resumes for better job opportunities. It checks content
structure, keyword relevance, and missing skills to improve resume quality and ATS compatibility. The application guides
students with smart feedback, making resumes professional, optimized, and ready for competitive recruitment processes.
